crossRefs.note: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.

translations.web: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
translations.bsb: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
translations.kjv: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
translations.asv: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.
